steps.clue: Collect the Thrustodyne parts from the bowling alley, Groundskeeper’s shed and Radio House.
Build the Thrustodyne and receive Dr. Panos’s instructions in the church.
Use the Thrustodyne to collect the three LTG parts.
Build the LTG on the bank rooftop.
Defend the LTG, capture an HVT’s essence, then return the first canister.
Use the Strauss Counter to calibrate three projectors and release the second canister.
Move the LTG, repeat the HVT capture, then return the second canister.
Activate the S.D.G. in the church to begin the final encounter.
Survive the church lockdown, defeating the HVT Mangler and Abomination.
